fitted_124_forensics.notes: Distinctness compares full ordered size, target c0, reference c0 trajectories, not just fitted slopes. R-squared null means zero variance in log target-to-reference ratio. Drop-largest admission and verdict are case-level, requiring all three streams. Baseline screen confusion counts are restricted to admitted cases; unadmitted cases are not counted as negative. B1 and B2 require the named threshold on every stream. B4 requires at least four eligible sizes spanning at least eightfold on every stream. B5 uses the largest common uncapped size of each stream, admits when max target or reference CPU is >=10000 usec and reference CPU is positive, and requires ratio >=1.50 on all three streams.

s1_run_window.notes: Window includes failed attempts. Workflow mode is null because batch_log.json does not record it; no mode is inferred from session identities.

six_alerts.notes: Streams S1 through S3 follow ascending original stream names. Generic means a bare single-letter or numeric label, optionally prefixed by stream, s, g, family, uniform, shape, pattern or case. Sizes are common complete sizes across all four sides and all five modes. All fits call the archived predict.calculate_fit; dual screens require slope >=0.50 and largest ratio >=1.50. Auxiliary slope is null if any count is nonpositive. Restoration uses the two largest common sizes; nonpositive excess has null recovery percent and pass flag. All-stream restoration requires positive excess in each stream and no failing positive check. CPU lists use these same common sizes; CPU fits use only sizes with both sides >=10000 usec.
